_comment: One record per supplier invoice. Copy into the PRIVATE register (not this repository). Fill from the original invoice; leave accountantDecision null until the accountant answers in writing. Values below are placeholders.

supplier.name: <legal entity exactly as on the invoice>
supplier.taxId: <supplier VAT/tax ID as printed, or 'none printed'>

service.class: cloud_hosting | saas_subscription | software_licence | ai_api_usage | payment_processing | domain_registration | email_delivery | advertising | marketplace_fee | professional_service | other

invoice.vatCountry: <country whose VAT was charged, or null>
invoice.customerIdentifierPrinted: <which Colleague AI identifier the invoice prints>
